title: A different model family is preferred, never required
situation: The illustrator and the second assayer are bound to another model family than the builders, so when that family's quota runs out (OpenAI and Google on 2026-10-12, OpenRouter earlier) the work stops. Under 0142(2) a requirement is enforced only where the harm it prevents has been observed; no harm from a same-family illustrator or assayer has been.
decision: The illustrator, check-writer and assayers run on another model family than the builders where one is available, and on any available model otherwise; a cold reader is one that has not written the concepts, a fresh session reading only the journal, which any model can be. Unavailability of a family never stops the work.
consequences: The simplification cut proceeds on the available family.
